description: External (host) Top-k service times used by the S-path designs. GPU is an assumption, not a measurement. CPU values are medians of 30 timed repetitions (10 warm-up) of tools/bench/host_topk.cpp: 8 threads, spawn/join included, nth_element + final sort + index sort, stable BF16 order (score descending, index ascending, +0 == -0), membership checked against the replay expected indices. Measured on the development host; re-measure with tools.measure_host_topk on your own machine. The simulator uses cpu_measured (first idle repetition); cpu_repeat is a second idle repetition kept for variability.

cpu_retained_per_head_ms.note: Earlier per-head CPU measurement used by the per-bank refresh study of POP_S_CPU (refresh-policy reference set).
